mentions.name: Voice-only LLM document editor
mentions.description: A voice-controlled LLM document editor: tap a button, tell the assistant how to update the document, and watch the changes flow in. Open source, made for friends and family, with the current use case of tracking a house renovation project.
mentions.problem: The author could not find any open source project (or product) that does voice-only LLM document editing.
mentions.audience: Making it for friends and family; current use case is keeping track of a house renovation project.
mentions.source_excerpt:
LLM document editor using your voice only.

Sounds basic, and it is, but I've yet to find any open source project (let alone product) that does this.

All I want to tap a button, talk to the little guy about how to update my document, and see the changes flow.
